name: Cape Coast

requests.outcome: Fetched official Lands Commission site. General institutional and service information was available; no public parcel viewer or parcel API was exposed.

Official Survey and Mapping Division page describes supervision of land survey/demarcation, custody of parcel survey records, plan preparation/amendment and mapping. No anonymous parcel response, schema or CRS was exposed.
Official fee page lists cadastral/parcel-plan, registry-map search and map-sheet services. It is administrative fee evidence, not an open parcel data service.

Cape Coast Metropolitan Assembly official page states that its Physical Planning Department collaborates with the Lands Commission Survey and Mapping Division. No parcel ID or geometry endpoint was exposed.
Official Central Region page provides Cape Coast regional land-administration context and states that some lands are administered by the Lands Commission. No parcel geometry service was exposed.

Fetched current public online-portal shell and followed its linked public route pages. The shell and route pages exposed login forms and service navigation, but no anonymous cadastral map/API route, JavaScript parcel configuration, schema, CRS or ID-plus-geometry response. No login or form submission was attempted.
Public service route returned HTML with login-gated service content; no parcel response.

schemaCrs.details: No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained, so native fields, identity stability, geometry encoding and CRS remain unknown.

scopeLimits: The Lands Commission and its Survey and Mapping Division are evidenced as the cadastral custodian, and Cape Coast local administrative collaboration is evidenced; this does not prove an open citywide parcel layer.
The online portal was inspected only anonymously. Login walls are an access limitation, not evidence of parcel absence.
No exact-point query was issued because no public parcel endpoint was discovered; the exact WUP point was not shifted and no point miss is inferred.
No map extent miss, timeout, login wall or unusable UI is treated as citywide cadastral absence.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native ID plus full parcel polygon was verified.
uncertainty: Moderate to high: an official national/central-region cadastral custodian and local planning relationship are verified, but the public portal does not expose an anonymous parcel service. A serial reviewer must independently qualify any future adapter or authenticated/public endpoint.
